description: This file defines Kubernetes custom resource types for 'Carp', including its spec, status, conditions, and list, with associated metadata and references to external Kubernetes API packages.

classes.name: Carp
classes.description: A custom resource representing a collection of containers with metadata, spec, and status.

classes.name: CarpStatus
classes.description: Represents the current status of a Carp, including phase, conditions, messages, and IPs.

classes.name: CarpCondition
classes.description: Details about specific conditions of a Carp, such as readiness, with timestamps and reasons.

classes.name: CarpInfo
classes.description: Additional informational data associated with a Carp, keyed by A, B, and optional C.

classes.name: CarpSpec
classes.description: Specification of desired state and configuration for a Carp, including restart policy, node selector, and network options.

classes.name: CarpList
classes.description: A list type for holding multiple Carp objects.
